---
description: Revisit a previously covered concept with the Revibe Mentor
agent: revibe
---

I want to review a concept I've already covered. The topic I want to revisit is in my message (treat the rest of my message as the topic).

Steps:

1. Read `memory/MEMORY.md` to confirm the topic is in "Concepts Mastered" or "Concepts In Progress". If it isn't, say so honestly and ask whether I want to start it as a new lesson instead.
2. If it is, run a short review: pose one question that probes my actual understanding (not vocabulary), wait for my answer, then give one micro-exercise that reuses the idea in a slightly different shape.
3. After the review, ask whether the concept still feels solid. If yes, leave it in "Mastered". If shaky, move it to "Concepts In Progress" and append a Session Log entry noting the review.

Do not give solution code. Follow `.github/agents/revibe.agent.md`.
